description:
This is a screenshot of the CLC+ (next-generation land cover/land use) Core application's "Data Catalogue" user interface. The top navigation bar includes "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users", along with "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support". Below this, a control panel features "Filter", tabs for "My organisation/s", "My data", "Ingestions", "Extractions", "100 meters", and "10 meters", followed by a "Search" field. Green buttons "ADD INGESTION" and "ADD EXTRACTION" are also visible.

The main part of the screen displays a table of data records with the following columns: "EAGLE Approved", "Name", "Type", "Created At", "Created By", "Country", "Region", "Reference Year", "Time Range", "Organisation/s", "Status", and "Resolution".

The table lists 10 records out of a total of 140, with "Items per page: 10".
